receipt.method: Three alternating observations. Fresh private guest caches followed by warm replay; OS/shared host-tool caches are not flushed. Admission wait excluded. Instrumentation disabled.
receipt.rss_limit: GNU time maximum RSS for the build command and its waited children, not a summed concurrent process-tree or cgroup peak.
